England Cricketer Harry Brook Explains Fatigue Before India Series

England cricket captain Harry Brook stated that he was fatigued before the series against India due to continuous play. He revealed this reason himself. Brook also expressed a desire to play in the Indian Premier League (IPL) a year after opting out of it.
